objective: reduce B2 false fires by adding model-mined negative windows while holding geometry, training recipe, threshold, and event ruler fixed

candidate_bank.source: strict-time empty-background sampler used by P1
candidate_bank.train_val_isolation: candidate full windows must remain in their original frozen time block

round1_dataset.base_rows: all P1 B2 positives and easy negatives unchanged
round1_dataset.addition: all unseen candidate negatives fired by B2 at conf=0.35
round1_dataset.hard_negative_label: empty YOLO label; never derived from future profit/loss

training.augmentations: same disabled flip/mosaic/mixup/hsv recipe as P1 B2

evaluation.density_acceptance_gate: not_frozen_by_owner; report deltas only and do not promote
